# OpenCode Plugins (oplugin.com)

Trend/ranking site for the OpenCode plugin marketplace.
Source of truth: https://github.com/awesome-market/awesome-opencode-market
(catalog branch → https://awesome-market.github.io/awesome-opencode-market/index.json)

## Pages
- / — boards (daily/weekly/monthly downloads & stars growth, new, total)
- /repos/<owner>__<name> — per-plugin page: metrics, growth, history chart,
  verification report, latest version
- /tags/<slug> — plugins grouped by category
- /langs/plugin · /langs/skill — entry-type boards

## Data (stable JSON, CC0-style open)
- /data/index.json — day/month/year rollup index
- /data/days/<YYYY-MM-DD>.json — board placements for a day
- /data/repos/<owner>__<name>.json — entity detail incl. metrics, growth,
  history, verification{status,level,run_url}, approval, capabilities
- /data/tags-index.json — all tag pages

## Column semantics
`downloads30d` = npm downloads in trailing 30d; `downloads_month` =
month-to-date downloads; `stars` = repository stars.
Runtime pages consume only these static files — never the upstream catalog.

Generated by CI sync (scripts/sync_catalog.py); updated twice daily UTC.
